notes: Reviewed meaning-preserving EN/ES acceptance copy for all four closed IDs.
Warmth-eligible turns may differ in cadence/emoji; truth-frozen turns must be identical.
Spanish is peninsular (vale, móvil, vosotros) — never Latin-American.

cases.meaning: welcome the guest and offer to help book a stay

replies.sunny: Hey! Welcome to Wolf-House 🌊 I can help you book a stay — what dates are you thinking?

replies.concise: Welcome — I can help you book a stay. Dates?
replies.extra: Yesss welcome to Wolf-House!! 🌊🙌🐺 So happy you're here! I can help you book a stay — what dates are you dreaming of? 😊
